sbe:messageSchema.description: Node-local replay control protocol between a ReplayerService and its co-located clients

sbe:message.name: ReplayRequest
sbe:message.description: A client asks its replayer for history: the active recording from its start (cold start, fromPosition -1), or from fromPosition (after a gap). Every recording a node holds starts at globalSeqNo 1, so the active one alone is complete

field.name: clientId
field.description: The client's id, unique among the replayer's co-located clients

field.name: requestId
field.description: Incremented on every send, including an unchanged resend, and echoed in the reply. The client ignores a reply whose requestId is not its current one (R-1): a resend supersedes the in-flight replay, so a reply to the earlier request may still be queued on the control stream

field.name: fromPosition
field.description: Position to resume the active recording from (SequencedEvent.position of the last in-order frame), or FROM_START (-1) for the recording's start

sbe:message.name: Replaying
sbe:message.description: The replayer started a replay. The client attaches to replaySessionId on stream 201, follows it until catchUpPosition, then switches to the live tap, de-duplicating on globalSeqNo

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

field.name: replaySessionId
field.description: Aeron replay session to attach to on stream 201 (Subscription.imageBySessionId), or NO_REPLAY_NEEDED (-1) when there is nothing to replay from there: for FROM_START the client is at the tip; for a position, that position is no good here, and a client with a hole open replays from the start (R-2)

field.name: catchUpPosition
field.description: Position at which the replay ends and the client switches to the live tap. The client detects completion by reaching it, not by image close: a bounded replay of an active recording does not close its image at the bound

sbe:message.name: ReplayPending
sbe:message.description: All MAX_CONCURRENT_REPLAYS slots are busy. The client waits at its gap, without advancing past it, until a later Replaying arrives

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

sbe:message.name: ReplayComplete
sbe:message.description: The client has caught up and switched to the live tap; the replayer frees its slot now rather than at the idle timeout

sbe:message.name: ReplayHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: Sent about every 500 ms while the client's replay image is running; resets the slot's idle timeout (R-3). A replay has no time limit, so without this a long replay would lose its slot. A client that dies stops sending, and its slot is reclaimed

sbe:message.name: ReplayUnavailable
sbe:message.description: This node cannot serve history for the replayer's lifetime: at start-up its active tap recording did not start at globalSeqNo 1 (deleted, corrupted or partially restored). Unlike ReplayPending, this is permanent. Refusing keeps the fault in the replayer; serving the replay would make every client fail its own check that history starts at 1

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the refused request (R-1)

sbe:message.name: ReplayClientIdInUse
sbe:message.description: Two processes on this node are requesting under one clientId: their requestId sequences interleave, so each supersedes the other's replay and neither catches up. Sent to the id, so both receive it and neither can tell which was there first; a client that does fails its duty cycle

sbe:message.name: SnapshotQuery
sbe:message.description: Asks for the sequenced SnapshotEnd of one source's round, the one the asking instance holds locally (doc/snapshot.md §5)

sbe:message.name: SnapshotLocation
sbe:message.description: Where the queried round starts in this node's active recording, and the source's sequenced SnapshotEnd for it; round -1 if the index holds no such end

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the query this answers (R-1)

field.name: asOfGlobalSeqNo
field.description: R, the globalSeqNo of the round's SnapshotStarted

field.name: asOfPosition
field.description: Position of that SnapshotStarted in the active recording
